recipes.name: Standard Feature
recipes.purpose: Default implementation flow for ordinary product work.
recipes.instructions: Goal -> minimal context plan -> Implementer -> Tester -> cross-model Reviewer -> Documentation Delta -> Project Intelligence -> context GC.

recipes.name: Evidence-Driven Bug Fix
recipes.purpose: Reproduce and repair defects without masking regressions.
recipes.instructions: Reproduce -> minimal regression context -> regression test -> isolate root cause -> fix -> suite -> review -> docs/intelligence -> GC.

recipes.name: Architecture Change
recipes.purpose: Safely modify system boundaries or public contracts.
recipes.instructions: Explorer -> Architect -> ADR -> impact/context plan -> staged implementation -> tests -> cross-provider review -> docs/intelligence.

recipes.name: Release
recipes.instructions: Freeze Goal -> clean build -> test matrix -> security/performance -> migration/docs -> artifacts -> release verifier -> release intelligence.

recipes.name: Web Feature
recipes.instructions: Contract/design -> minimal context -> implementation -> unit/E2E -> accessibility/security -> docs delta.

recipes.name: Security Review
recipes.instructions: Threat model -> bounded context -> automated/manual abuse checks -> findings -> remediation -> re-test.

recipes.name: UI/UX Review
recipes.instructions: Capture representative states -> heuristic/accessibility review -> visual regression -> prioritized findings -> re-check.

recipes.name: Engine Renderer Change
recipes.instructions: Architecture impact -> symbol/context slices -> visual fixture -> implementation -> GPU/CPU benchmark -> visual tests -> independent review.

recipes.name: Multiplayer Feature
recipes.instructions: Authority contract -> protocol -> implementation -> latency/loss -> security -> docs/intelligence.

recipes.name: Compiler/Language Change
recipes.instructions: Spec -> conformance tests -> frontend/IR/runtime -> diagnostics -> compatibility -> docs/intelligence.

recipes.name: Documentation Refactor
recipes.instructions: Inventory truth -> identify drift -> preserve audience/task structure -> virtual chunking -> update ATLAS -> validate site/links; do not create LLM-only duplicate docs.

recipes.name: Project Bootstrap
recipes.purpose: Create a Project Atlas project from explicit project and AI preferences.
recipes.instructions: Gather project/AI preferences -> JSON atlas config -> resolve smallest workforce -> scaffold docs/Goals/intelligence -> set LPC budgets -> validate.
